plugin.name: Rascal Debugger
plugin.description:
Works with any Maven-based Rascal project. Does NOT provide Rascal syntax highlighting or editing (diagnostics/completion/CodeLenses) by itself.
See this repo's own README for those two separate, required one-time setup steps before installing this.
